summary: Leave a host name's record alone

parameters.name: recordID
parameters.description: ID of the dynamic DNS record of a host name, as the list shows it

400.description: The record is not a name that holds another record (`error.host-dns-leave-refused`)

403.description: The user lacks a needed right

404.description: The record or its host does not exist or the user may not see it

description:
A name of a host held another record, so nothing was written. This removes the record row and leaves the name as it is at the provider; the name is no longer ticked.

Needs: the manage right of the record's host type
